```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
sqlTestLive = `
SELECT
    r.code_cultu,
    COALESCE(d.nom_culture, r.code_cultu) AS nom_culture,
    COALESCE(d.nom_chapitre, 'Non classé') AS nom_chapitre,
    COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('${RPG_URL}') r
LEFT JOIN dico d ON r.code_cultu = d.code_culture
WHERE r.code_cultu IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY n DESC
`
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
liveQueryDemo({
  sql: sqlTestLive,
  mapRow: (d) => ({
    code_cultu: d.code_cultu,
    nom_culture: d.nom_culture,
    nom_chapitre: d.nom_chapitre,
    n: Number(d.n)
  }),
  valueField: "n",
  searchFields: ["nom_culture", "nom_chapitre", "code_cultu"],
  columns: ["nom_culture", "nom_chapitre", "n", "part"],
  header: {
    nom_culture: "Culture",
    nom_chapitre: "Famille",
    n: "Parcelles",
    part: "Proportion"
  },
  width: { nom_culture: 200, nom_chapitre: 200, n: 90, part: 160 },
  searchPlaceholder: "🔍 Rechercher une culture ou une famille…"
})
```
